expectations.name: module-audit-merges-every-dimension
expected_behavior: States the target, the three packages, the four dimensions, `mustx` as the only library to reshape, and the worker count before dispatching
Dispatches no separate `go:style` worker; style offenses arrive through `review`
Grades the nil dereference in `svc.Run` a Blocker, and the untested truncated-header path and the stale `config.Load` godoc Should-fix
Every finding cites `file:line` and names a fix command of its owning skill (`/go:review ./svc fix`, `/go:cover parse/…:<line>`, `/go:doc config/…:<line>`)
Lists the `mustx` proposals in a Library API section apart from the severity tiers, and names `gopkg.in/yaml.v3` as not reshaped
Gives a Fix order that puts library API changes and `review` correctness before style, `doc`, and `cover`
Edits no source file and writes no plan file; the `Ran:` line names `cover`'s `go test` runs
Report is terse: no preamble or narration, and a verdict with per-severity counts that match the findings listed

expectations.name: overlapping-findings-merge-once
expected_behavior: Reports the untested empty-input branch in `Decode` once, as `cover`'s finding, not also as `review`'s
Reports the `ErrShort`/`ErrTruncated` godoc mismatch once, as a Should-fix naming both the `doc` and style dimensions
Grades no `cover` or `doc` finding a Blocker
Says the reshape dimension had nothing to run because no imported module is editable

expectations.name: restricted-dimensions-no-editable-library
expected_behavior: Runs no `cover` worker and reports no coverage findings
Reshapes no library by default, never `internal/util`, and names `cobra`, `yaml.v3`, and `x/sync` as not reshaped
Grades the `%v` wrap a Blocker under correctness, naming the style rule it also breaks, once
Says the reshape dimension had nothing to run
